notice.title: Sorry — we broke Fixture Planner
notice.message:
Fixture Planner stopped loading fixtures because of a bad deploy on our side. That’s fixed now.

If anything still looks stuck, hard refresh the page (Cmd+Shift+R on Mac, Ctrl+Shift+R on Windows).

Sorry for the hassle — and thanks for bearing with us.
